rule.description: Production code under src/ must be reachable at runtime from the package public entry point src/index.ts: a branch guarded by an ambient constant the package never defines at runtime can never execute, and a module-scope declaration that no reachable code references is dead production code.

checks.description: Detect ambient constants the package itself declares in a declaration file but never assigns a runtime value, leaving every guard that consults them permanently falsy.
checks.detected_relation: ambient declaration -> zero references from runtime-reachable package code
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: An environment constant that the published package never defines cannot influence runtime behavior; the declaration and everything gated on it are dead production surface kept alive only by an impossible condition.

matches.evidence: src/types/legacyEnvironment.d.ts:9:15 ambient constant 'REACT_TO_PRINT_LEGACY_FLOW' is declared by this package but never defined at runtime, and no reachable code references it (every reference sits inside the branches listed by the ambient-guarded-branch check, which can never execute).

checks.description: Detect module-scope declarations (variable, function, class, interface, type alias) with no reference from any code reachable from the public entry point. References from permanently unreachable guarded branches do not keep a symbol alive.
checks.detected_relation: module-scope declaration -> zero live references under reachability from src/index.ts
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A production symbol that no reachable code path can ever touch is dead code carried by the package: it ships in the build, must pass the repository's type-aware checks, and will never execute.

src/utils/printPreviewViewport.ts:36:17 'resolvePrintViewport' (function) is not reachable from the public entry point src/index.ts; no reachable module imports it.

src/utils/generatePrintWindow.ts:44:17 'applyLegacyViewportFallback' (function) is not reachable from the public entry point src/index.ts; it is imported only by the orphaned print window manager module.

checks.description: Detect branches whose guard condition requires an ambient constant that the package declares but never defines at runtime, making the guard always falsy and the guarded statements unreachable no matter which options a consumer passes.
checks.detected_relation: guarded branch -> always-falsy guard on a never-defined ambient constant
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The branch looks like a caller-controlled feature switch, but the flag can never be truthy in the published package, so the guarded block is unreachable production code that still ships compiles and is maintained as if it ran.

src/utils/handlePrintWindowOnLoad.ts:247:9 branch in function 'handlePrintWindowOnLoad' is guarded by an ambient constant that is never defined at runtime; the guarded code can never execute.
src/utils/clone.ts:29:5 branch in function 'cloneShadowRoots' is guarded by an ambient constant that is never defined at runtime; the guarded code can never execute.
src/utils/getContentNode.ts:32:5 branch in function 'getContentNode' is guarded by an ambient constant that is never defined at runtime; the guarded code can never execute.

excluded.candidate: src/types/font-face.d.ts global document and window type augmentation
excluded.reason: Ambient interface augmentations of browser-provided types are consumed by the TypeScript compiler on behalf of consumers, are not value-bearing environment constants, and are never used as branches; the rule considers only ambient value declarations (declare const/declare var).

excluded.candidate: Option-driven branches in the public API, e.g. if (fonts), if (print), if (documentTitle), if (copyShadowRoots), if (onBeforePrint)
excluded.reason: These branches are guarded by values the caller controls through documented hook options, so they are reachable runtime behavior and not matches of the rule.

excluded.candidate: Defensive host-environment checks in src/utils/startPrint.ts (print availability, mobile browser detection) and canvas index guards in src/utils/handlePrintWindowOnLoad.ts
excluded.reason: These branches depend on the runtime host rather than package-internal flags and are intentionally retained compatible behavior; they remain reachable and are not related to the smell.
